select t.tal_id as talentId, t.tal_status as status, t.tal_matched_score as matchedScore, t.tal_current_round as currentRound, t.tal_resume_id as resumeId, u.nick_name as name, u.phonenumber as phone, u.email as email, r.rbs_job_direction as jobDirection, (select group_concat(tg_name separator ',') from t_tal_tag where tg_candidate_id = t.tal_id) as tags from t_tal t left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id left join t_res_base r on r.rbs_id = t.tal_resume_id where t.tal_company_id = #{companyId}
and (u.nick_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.phonenumber like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and exists (select 1 from t_tal_tag tg where tg.tg_candidate_id = t.tal_id and tg.tg_name = #{tag})
order by t.tal_id desc

select t.tal_id as talentId, t.tal_status as status, t.tal_matched_score as matchedScore, t.tal_current_round as currentRound, t.tal_resume_id as resumeId, u.user_id as userId, u.nick_name as name, u.phonenumber as phone, u.email as email, r.rbs_resume_name as resumeName, r.rbs_job_direction as jobDirection from t_tal t left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id left join t_res_base r on r.rbs_id = t.tal_resume_id where t.tal_id = #{talId} and t.tal_company_id = #{companyId}
select tg_name as name, tg_source as source from t_tal_tag where tg_candidate_id = #{talId} order by tg_id

select edu_school as school, edu_major as major, edu_degree as degree, date_format(edu_start_date, '%Y-%m') as startDate, date_format(edu_end_date, '%Y-%m') as endDate from t_res_education where edu_resume_id = #{resumeId} order by edu_end_date desc

select wrk_company as company, wrk_position as position, date_format(wrk_start_date, '%Y-%m') as startDate, case when wrk_is_current = 1 then '至今' else date_format(wrk_end_date, '%Y-%m') end as endDate, wrk_description as summary from t_res_work where wrk_resume_id = #{resumeId} order by wrk_start_date desc
select prj_name as name, prj_role as role, prj_tech_stack as techStack, prj_description as summary from t_res_project where prj_resume_id = #{resumeId} order by prj_start_date desc
select skl_name as name, skl_level as level from t_res_skill where skl_resume_id = #{resumeId} order by skl_level desc, skl_id
select count(*) from t_res_education where edu_resume_id = #{resumeId}
select count(*) from t_res_work where wrk_resume_id = #{resumeId}
select count(*) from t_res_project where prj_resume_id = #{resumeId}
select count(*) from t_res_skill where skl_resume_id = #{resumeId}
